## 1.117.2 - 2026-05-17

### Documentation
- `baoyu-cover-image`: ban programmatic text repair on generated bitmaps — disallow ImageMagick / Pillow / Canvas / SVG / HTML overlays to cover, rewrite, or replace title/subtitle text; regenerate from a corrected prompt or switch to a lower-text or no-title variant instead
- `baoyu-article-illustrator`, `baoyu-comic`, `baoyu-image-cards`, `baoyu-xhs-images`, `baoyu-infographic`, `baoyu-slide-deck`: sync the same text-repair ban with skill-specific text categories (labels/captions, dialogue/sound effects, titles/body/tags, headings/data values, slide titles/bullets)

llm.summary: This skill coherently automates drafting Weibo posts in Chrome, with disclosed browser, clipboard, local file, and saved-session use, but users should understand the operational risks.

dimensions.detail: The scripts match the stated purpose: they open Weibo, fill post or article editors, upload user-selected media, and leave final publishing for manual user review.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions disclose Chrome CDP use, clipboard paste, saved login behavior, and scoped automatic recovery; the behavior is sensitive but tied to Weibo posting.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill requires bun or npx and declares npm dependencies. No hidden install hook or startup mechanism was found, though package.json uses caret ranges despite a lockfile with resolved versions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It reads user-provided Markdown and media files, writes temporary HTML, uses the system clipboard, opens Weibo, and uses a Chrome profile; these are proportionate to browser-based post composition.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Weibo login persists in the Chrome profile, and recovery may terminate matching remote-debugging Chrome processes for that profile. No privilege escalation, broad persistence, or unrelated background worker was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a skill opening a real Chrome session, using a saved Weibo login profile, overwriting the clipboard during article composition, uploading files you provide to Weibo, and terminating its own stuck CDP Chrome profile during recovery. Use a dedicated Chrome profile and review the browser draft before publishing.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] expected: The real paste keystroke behavior is present and focus-sensitive, but the article workflow first places generated HTML or selected images on the clipboard and uses it to fill Weibo editors; it is disclosed rather than hidden.
[SDI-2] expected: The process termination helper is real but scoped to command lines containing the chosen profile directory and a remote-debugging flag; it does not show broad Chrome-killing behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Automatic cleanup without confirmation is disclosed in troubleshooting and is limited to the skill's CDP profile, but users should prefer a dedicated Chrome profile to avoid disrupting unrelated automation work.
[SC1] unexpected: The caret dependency ranges are a supply-chain hygiene issue, but a bun.lock with resolved versions and integrity hashes is present, and this is not evidence of malicious behavior.
[suspicious.dangerous_exec] expected: Static command-execution findings correspond to fixed clipboard, paste, WSL path, and process-management helpers needed for the disclosed browser automation; no arbitrary command execution or exfiltration path was found.
